INCIDENT RECONSTRUCTION

What the signals suggest

  1. 14:00–14:27Five accounts receive funds from multiple unrelated counterparties.
  2. 14:31–14:43Each account sends a high-value payment toward the same cash-out counterparty.
  3. LinkageThe accounts use the same newly observed web device.
  4. AlternativeA shared service provider or coordinated legitimate operation must be tested before escalation.

STEP 04 · EXECUTIVE BRIEF

Turn the finding into a defensible control improvement.

The evidence supports escalation of the linked cluster and targeted review of new-device payouts. It does not support treating every shared device or high fan-in account as fraud.
